name: Christmas Crack
desc: Saltine crackers baked under brown sugar toffee and spread with melted chocolate, then broken into pieces.

source.title: Christmas Crack (Saltine Cracker Toffee)
source.evidence: Same 1 cup butter and 1 cup brown sugar; supplies the saltine count (40, about 1 sleeve).

ingredients.raw: 1 cup (220 g) packed light brown sugar
2 cups (one 12 oz bag) semisweet chocolate chips
Nonstick cooking spray, for the foil

steps: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with heavy-duty foil (spray regular foil with cooking spray). Lay the crackers on it in a single layer, edges touching.
Melt the butter and brown sugar in a medium saucepan over medium heat and bring to a rolling boil. Reduce to medium-low and boil 5 minutes, stirring often.
Pour the toffee over the crackers right away and spread to cover them completely.
Bake 5 minutes, until bubbling all over. Remove from the oven and scatter the chocolate chips on top.
Let stand 1-2 minutes, until the chocolate looks shiny and soft, then spread it evenly. If it will not spread after 4 minutes, return the pan to the turned-off oven for 1 minute.
Sprinkle with pecans or sprinkles, if using. Refrigerate 1-2 hours until hard, then peel off the foil and break into pieces.
